test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The Ganga Plain extends between Ghaggar and Teesta rivers, of which about 79% area of the basin is in India. How many states and Union Territories does the basin cover?
solution:
The correct answer is __**11**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ganga River

 
 
• The Ganga rises from the Gangotri glacier near Gomukh in the Uttarkashi district of the state of Uttarakhand.
 
• The total length of the Ganga is about 2,510 km.
 
• The Ganga river drains into the Bay of Bengal before forming a very huge delta.
 
• The Ganga initially flows in the southern direction, then in the south-east direction up to Mirzapur and then in the east direction in the Bihar plains.
 
• In Bangladesh, it gets divided into two main distributaries- the Bhagirathi and the Hugli.
 
• The main river goes to Bangladesh where it is firstly known by the name of the Padma and then the Meghna which drains into the Bay of Bengal. 
 
• It is the largest river basin in India and accounts for about one-fourth of the total area of the country.
 
• It covers the states of Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Bihar, West Bengal, Uttarakhand, Jharkhand, Haryana, Chhattisgarh, Himachal Pradesh, and Union Territory of Delhi.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ghaggar River**

 
 
• The Ghaggar River rises in Shivalik hills in the Solan district of Himachal Pradesh.
 
• It enters Haryana from the Panchkula district.
 
• Then after the river flows making the border between Punjab and Haryana for more than 100 Km.
 
• And at the end, the river leaves Sirsa District of Haryana State and reaches Sri Ganga Nagar district, Rajasthan.
 
 
 
• **Teesta River**
 
 
• Sikkim states is the source of Teesta River located.
 
• Teesta River originates from the Tso Lhamo Lake at an elevation of about 5280 m in the North Sikkim district.
 
• It is the right bank major tributary of the Brahmaputra river system.
 
• The major portion or the greater part of the river basin lies in India and only 17% of it is in Bangladesh.
 
• The Indian portion of the Teesta basin lies in the mountainous terrain of Sikkim and West Bengal.
